column1: # PEANUTS: the game holds itself to 30 fps with its own limiter (present interval 1): main+0x6a8310 sets the frame rate (main+0xc97ce4, i32, 60 in the image, 30 set at start by
# main+0x4533ec) and main+0x6c7ef0 the frame time in us (main+0xc97d18, round(1000000 / fps)); the main loop (main+0x6c7c50) sleeps the frame time less the frame's elapsed time.
# The game has a 30 / 60 'FPS' debug item (main+0x3e0c74) and per-frame code that checks for 60 (main+0x41549c, +0x487354); its game clock steps by the measured time, at most 1/30 s
# (main+0x506e7c). Reviewed rows of our own (no FPSLocker Warehouse config for this build), main 1.2.1 only: the host's frame limit picks the rate, 30 by default (what the game
# sets itself), 60 the launcher's choice; Game owned applies none. 45 / 40 / 20 are not offered: the per-frame code checks for exactly 60, and the clock caps a step at 1/30 s
